evaluation_scope: EMOPEC SD activity and RNAfold local structure; not measured protein yield or RNA half-life.
selection_rule: Prefer designs meeting all requirements; equal mean percentile rank across declared objectives; earliest candidate breaks ties for independent sampling. Agent chooses its own final.
comparison_rule: Report raw per-case objective values, validity, feasibility, nondominance and actual costs. Internal search ranks are not comparable across methods.
hard_constraints: Fixed gene context and full CDS unchanged
Only the specified six SD bases editable
scope: Original empirical SD model with declared RNAfold version and local window; no absolute enzyme-activity or protein-yield prediction.
